_about: Council DCP rules that must never be served in any property's main rule list. Each entry is the user-approved result of a review: the rule applies to a small area we cannot map, so it is shown only in the 'may apply' block (frontend-nextjs/shared/may-apply-areas.json) and is stored v2_is_actionable = FALSE, v2_dcp_layer = 'precinct', v2_precinct_id = NULL. Read by scripts/never_serve.py: derive_precinct_keys, gate_rules, enrichment, dcp_extract_changed, rerun_actionable_classifier and sync_v2_to_supabase skip these ids; DQ-148 fails if any is served (by id, or by text for a re-read that minted new ids) or if a listed id stops being current.

entries.name: cb-2-2-carinya-road-flood
entries.why: Chapter 2.2 clause 4.4 applies only to the Carinya Road area in Picnic Point (Figure 4c). Keyed to 'C-B former Bankstown' on 2026-10-21 by a re-derive and served to all of former Bankstown; withheld and unkeyed 2026-10-22 (backups data/db_rollback_backups/carinya_road_withhold_pre_2026-10-22T201544.json, carinya_road_unkey_pre_2026-10-22T205445.json).

entries.name: parramatta-part10-late-night-trading
entries.why: Part 10 Late Night Trading: Table 10.1.1 (p1469-1470) applies the controls only 'Within an identified LNTA'; outside one they do not apply. The three LNTAs are all in the Parramatta City Centre (s10.2, p1473) and have no outline in our data, so a house cannot be placed inside one.

entries.name: inner-west-lep-named-lot-clauses
entries.why: Inner West LEP 2022 clauses 6.16-6.19 and 6.24-6.26 each apply only to named lots (Lot/DP in the clause, PDF pages 76-85 of the current consolidation read 2026-11-20). Exact-lot keying failed the build_site_boundaries proof for all seven (lots missing from our cadastre table, address point outside the outline, nearest-precinct fallback would hand the rules to 2-72 neighbouring lots), so the rows are withheld and listed as 'may apply' by suburb. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: ashfield-e2-section-2-3-140a-hawthorne
entries.why: Ashfield (Comprehensive Inner West DCP 2016) Chapter E2 page 1: 'The controls for 2.3 140A Hawthorne Parade, Haberfield only apply to the land marked A' on Figure 1. Section 2.3 (pages 21-22, rows L278 and L281-L295) was keyed to the whole Haberfield precinct and served to every Haberfield house, including controls for 'subdivision lots 16 and 17' and 'lots 10 and 11'. The site-outline proof for 140A Hawthorne Parade passed its address and lot checks but failed the nearest-precinct fallback check, so the rows are withheld and listed. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: cos-schedule-6-the-rocks-signage
entries.why: Sydney DCP 2012 Schedules, Schedule 6 (pages 20 to 37, opening page 20): 'This schedule provides information to assist tenants, consultants and fabricators on high quality signage appropriate for The Rocks precinct.' The whole schedule is for The Rocks and was served to every City of Sydney house. The Rocks has no outline in our data, so the rows are withheld and listed. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: woollahra-e1-table-3-centre-parking-multipliers
entries.why: Woollahra DCP 2015 Chapter E1, section E1.5.3 (page 19): 'In some centres the base parking generation rate for non-residential uses is discounted'; Table 3 (page 20) lists the centres. The table was served to every Woollahra house. The listed centres have no outlines in our data, so the rows are withheld and listed. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: woollahra-e1-8-5-double-bay-centre-parking
entries.why: Woollahra DCP 2015 Chapter E1, section E1.8.5 (page 26): 'This section applies to land within the Double Bay Centre as identified in Chapter D5 Double Bay Centre of this DCP.' It was served to every Woollahra house. Chapter D5 has its own centre outline, but these rows are keyed to no precinct, so they are withheld and listed. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: cos-signage-precincts-3-16-12
entries.why: Sydney DCP 2012 section 3.16 signage, page 107: 'Signage within a signage precinct, as shown on the Signage precincts map, is to be assessed against Section 3.16.12.' Section 3.16.12 holds the controls for named precincts (Millers Point, Wynyard, George Street, King Street Newtown, Pitt Street Mall and others). They were served to every City of Sydney house. The precincts have no outlines in our data, so the rows are withheld and listed. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).

entries.name: hornsby-pound-road-precinct
entries.why: Hornsby DCP 2024 Part 3 section 3.5 (pages 84 to 99): each of these controls is headed or worded as applying to the Pound Road, Hornsby Precinct (for example 'Setback Encroachments (Pound Road, Hornsby Precinct)', page 90). They were served to every Hornsby house. The precinct has no outline in our data, so the rows are withheld and listed. Rows for the rest of the area ('excluding Pound Road') are untouched. Withheld 2026-11-20 (owner yes).
